action_label: Confirm the VAT Rate Pack Is Approved
description: The pack for 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027 holds the five VAT control keys. A ZA Compliance Reviewer checks every value against the approved evidence and submits it. VAT Settings cannot be saved until it is approved.
